title: Trump Launches $6B Science Push in Largest Initiative in Decades
summary:
The White House introduced the "New Golden Age of Science," a coordinated investment program totaling more than $6 billion to fast-track advancements in nuclear fusion, quantum computing, space exploration and artificial intelligence. The initiative draws funding from government budgets, industry pledges, academia and philanthropy to ensure U.S. leadership in the development of "super intelligence," the administration said in a statement.

A central component of the push is the "Genesis Mission," which has secured $2.4 billion in computing resources from tech giants. Nvidia is contributing $1 billion in capacity over five years, while OpenAI and Amazon are providing $200 million and $50 million respectively. Anthropic pledged $150 million and is making its Claude AI available to more than 15 federal agencies. The initiative also includes $100 million in credits from National Compute for the White House and another $100 million for the public sector, alongside a 14 institution compute hub across 10 southeastern states.

TRUMP TO UNVEIL $1 BILLION+ AI SCIENCE PUSH

President Trump will attend a White House summit Thursday focused on using advanced AI to accelerate scientific breakthroughs and strengthen U.S. leadership.

The administration will announce more than $1 billion in industry commitments to its Genesis Mission from OpenAI, Anthropic, AMD and others.

Federal agencies will also invest over $100 million in AI-driven science tools, alongside a new 14-institution compute hub spanning 10 southeastern states.

selectedTweets.bestBit: NVIDIA is committing $1 BILLION in computing capacity over 5 years
selectedTweets.text:
🇺🇸 Trump is getting some of the biggest names in AI to put $2.4 BILLION worth of COMPUTING RESOURCES behind American SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH

NVIDIA, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon and Google are among the companies supporting the White House's GENESIS MISSION, which is now expanding to 14 additional federal agencies.

NVIDIA is committing $1 BILLION in computing capacity over 5 years. OpenAI is providing $200 MILLION in token discounts and training, Anthropic is offering $150 MILLION in access to Claude, and Amazon is contributing $50 MILLION in cloud credits.

The idea is to give government scientists access to powerful AI systems that could ACCELERATE DISCOVERIES in medicine, energy and advanced materials.

The real test will be whether cheaper access to AI translates into discoveries that would otherwise have taken years.

Source: POLITICO / Writer: Oliver
